data.long_meaning: One who has good qualities, Auspicious, Good fortune. data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Sukumar holds deep spiritual significance as it reflects the innate divine nature of the individual. The word "Sukumar" comes from the Sanskrit roots "Suku," which means "good," and "Mar," which means "human being." Thus, the name Sukumar signifies a good human being, one who embodies the qualities of truth, compassion, love, and wisdom. It is a reminder that every human being has the potential to be good and to live a life filled with happiness and success. Therefore, the name Sukumar holds a spiritual significance that inspires individuals to strive towards living a virtuous life and reaching their full potential.

vedic_reference.note: The name Sukumar is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shuku’, which means ‘good’ and ‘mār’ which means ‘death’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Sukumar, as he is considered the destroyer of all impurities and the giver of prosperity and good fortune.

historical_references.reference: Sukumar Chakraborty was a renowned Indian playwright, poet, and novelist. He is best known for his works in the Bengali language, particularly his plays which often dealt with social and political issues. He was born on 15 February 1921 in Kolkata, India, and passed away on 29 May 2004.

Sukumar Sen was a distinguished Indian mathematician, known for his contributions to graph theory and combinatorial mathematics. He was born on 4 July 1912 in Kolkata, India, and passed away on 14 March 1987. He received the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize in Mathematical Sciences in 1967.
